messages:
Sofia L: Heads-up — partners nudged a couple launch windows (H100/H200 + MI300) and SI teams are asking for a separate onboarding window. Need a short decision on whether we stagger SI GA or keep a single marketplace announce week.
NVIDIA - Raj: H200 NA slots slipped ~9 days due to supplier routing. We can do a joint announce if the copy uses a soft availability window. Partners want a 48h heads-up before public.
AMD - Mei: MI300 driver patch queued; if it lands tonight we can keep schedule, otherwise add one week to enablement. No change to NDAs.
Infra - Jun: Technical constraints: Gaudi kernel regen ~24h, full cross-region canary ~36h. Current canary manifest:
```
base: rwd-ubuntu-22.04-gpu:v2026-04
kernel: 6.1.78
cuda: 12.2
rocm: 5.9
model-optimizer: 3.2.4
```
Infra - Jun: If vendors flip firmware mid-cycle, regen + canary adds ~48h total. We can parallelize NA/EU canaries to reduce wall time.
SI - Polaris: Integrators requested a 2-week buffer after public to validate images before enabling managed SI accounts. Can we gate SI enrollments behind a separate GA?
Marketing - Lila: Prefer one clean public announce. My ask: make a soft-window public release and a follow-up SI GA 14 days later. Keeps press tidy and gives integrators runway.
Legal - Marco: We'll prepare two announcement variants (soft-window, firm-date). Partners must approve partner quotes; Legal needs ~24h for review once copy is tagged.
Sofia L: Proposed micro-plan:
- T0: partner pre-brief (48h pre-public)
- T+1: infra run kernel regen + parallel NA/EU canaries
- T+3: partner + legal signoff on chosen copy
- T+4: marketplace publish (blocked until canary green)
- T+18: SI GA (integrator onboarding after image distribution & extra validation)
release-bot: Canary job queued: canary-3612349999 -> https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/3612349999/logs
Infra - Jun: Spun up 4-node canary (2 NA, 1 EU, 1 APAC). Telemetry prefix: s3://redwood/partner-canaries/orbit-3612349999/. Including latency suite and mem leak checks.
release-bot: Canary started: canary-3612349999 (nodes=4)
Infra - Jun: Gaudi kernel regen finished, model-optimizer passes running. Expect perf baselines in ~3h.
NVIDIA - Raj: We'll provide preliminary perf bullets (marked "preliminary") and regional inventory notes.
AMD - Mei: Driver patch on track to land tonight. If anything regress, we'll call it here immediately.
Marketing - Lila: I'll draft soft-window copy + firm-date fallback. Also a short SI enablement email template for Day 18. ETA: EOD.
Legal - Marco: Tag us when drafts are ready. We'll prioritize the soft-window review. 24h turnaround requested.
release-bot: Canary completed: status=PASS, artifacts -> s3://redwood/partner-canaries/orbit-3612349999/artifacts.tgz
Infra - Jun: Canary PASS. No kernel panics. B200 thermal delta +2.3% peak in EU run; within SLO. Perf baselines uploaded to s3://redwood/partner-canaries/orbit-3612349999/metrics.json
SI - Polaris: Good. We'll schedule integrator image handoff on Day 6 so partners can start validation earlier. That should make Day 18 GA safe.
Marketing - Lila: Soft-window draft uploaded: https://docs.redwood/announcements/drafts/orbit-3612349999 (soft + firm + SI email). Tagging Legal and Partners.
Legal - Marco: Reviewing now. Quick note: partner quotes must be verbatim; any edits require partner signoff.
Sofia L: Action items: Jun confirm canary metrics link (done); Lila circulate assets (done); Marco review (in progress); Raj/Mei confirm partner prebrief timing (48h). I'll run partner sync tomorrow 09:00 PT to lock final windows.
NVIDIA - Raj: Confirmed for 48h prebrief. Will join call.
AMD - Mei: Oncall for the patch rollout.
Infra - Jun: Metrics link: https://s3.console.aws.redwood/partner-canaries/orbit-3612349999/metrics.json
release-bot: Reminder scheduled: partner-sync-call @ 2026-04-05T09:00:00-07:00
Sofia L: Decision for now: Proceed with public marketplace announce using soft-window copy if partners signoff; gate SI GA to Day 18 with image handoff Day 6. If any canary or partner approval fails, hold and use non-dated messaging. We'll confirm on the 09:00 PT call. :white_check_mark:
